Name: Pigeon Trinket Companion
Author: tinymangodragon
Description:
I like pigeons a normal amount, so I made a mod that turns your parrot and/or fairy trinket companion into a cute little pigeon with 25 different species to choose from!

[center]🕊️🕊️🕊️[/center]
[size=4][b]Version 2.0.0 Changelog[/b][/size]
It's been 84 years! I finally finished the update I started *checks notes* 13 months ago!!!! Please let me know if you encounter any issues!
Also if you enjoy this mod, please consider endorsing it! 😊

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Fairy compatibility![/b][/size] You can now turn your fairy companion into a pigeon as well! Both the parrot and fairy can be enabled or disabled individually in case you only want to use this mod for one of them.[/*]
[*][b][size=3]5 new pigeons![/size][/b] I added the White-crowned pigeon, Wonga Pigeon, Orange Dove, Void Pigeon, and Joja Pigeon! [/*]
[*][size=3][b]Pigeons now coo![/b][/size] (Only available for the parrot)[/*]
[*][size=3][b]Trinket retextures![/b][/size] For the parrot you can retexture the default blue Parrot egg to an unused cream-colored variant from the game's files. For the fairy you can retexture the default pink fairy box to a pigeon themed box with a matching variant for every single pigeon! You can either select a specific one, or have it automatically match your current selected pigeon![/*]
[/list]
Some changes: Minor adjustments to some of the older pigeon sprites, renamed "Wood Pigeon" to "Common Wood Pigeon"

To update your mod simply delete the folder of the old version and follow the instructions below under "How to install".

[center]🕊️🕊️🕊️[/center]
[b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b]

1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed.
2. Download this mod and extract the contents of the zip folder into your /Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder.
3. Run your game using SMAPI.
